criteria.reason: Fresh walk: the gate on one unfiled waived row filed exactly one issue (issue create with --label defect, title 'Defect: FS-9 Totals render without NaN', carrying the id and statement) and printed ok:true with filed, already and failed keys.

The issue body the stub gh received carries the criterion statement, the failure, its evidence, the feature, TRD, branch and ledger row, plus the verbatim 'Shipped waived under `Blocking: must-pass only` (verification.md §5c)... no Ensemble step closes it.' line.
Run with --closed-by owner, the body reads 'Waived under ... when the feature was closed by its owner.' and does not contain 'Shipped waived'.

Fresh walk: the ledger after the gate keeps the original line byte-for-byte (PREFIX-IDENTICAL-BYTE-FOR-BYTE) and appends one resolve marker for FS-9 reading 'filed https://github.com/stub-owner/stub-repo/issues/101'.
Fresh walk: with Tracker: none and no waived rows the gate printed ok:true and the stub gh call log for that run is empty.
Fresh walk: a [non-blocking] row followed by a later met row for FS-9 left FS-9 in neither filed nor failed, ok:true, and no gh call was made.
Fresh walk: when the stub refuses issue create the gate printed ok:false with a failed entry naming FS-9, its summary and the error 'stub: issue create refused'.

Fresh walk: with the ledger unwritable after a successful issue create, the gate printed ok:false and a failed entry carrying the error 'issue filed but the filed marker could not be written' and the stub URL issues/101.

Fresh headless /audit-build on fa-ok: the waived-defects gate (--state-dir, --stack, --closed-by audit) is the tool call before the closed.json write, closed.json is present afterwards and the run ended COMMAND COMPLETE.
Fresh headless /close-feature on fc-ok: the gate with --closed-by owner runs before closed.json is written, closed.json is present afterwards and the run ended COMMAND COMPLETE.

Fresh /audit-build on fa-fail refused correctly (STUCK names FS-1, its summary and the refusal error; no closed.json; no pr create), but its Next names only fixing the tracker then /audit-build, not filing by hand and running record-filed. The TRD says record-filed is a way out for any tracker; the audit-build command text (step 4) offers record-filed only for a Linear or Jira row, so for a GitHub refusal the Next omits it (the sibling fa-reopen run included it, so the output varies).

Fresh headless /close-feature on fc-fail with a refusing stub: no closed.json before or after, COMMAND STUCK naming FS-1 with its summary and the refusal error, and a Next naming the tracker fix then /close-feature.
Fresh re-audit of the already-closed fa-reopen: closed.json present before, the session ran rm -f on it after the gate refused, it is absent after, and the run ended COMMAND STUCK: /audit-build.

Fresh partly-failed refusals in both /close-feature (fc-fail) and /audit-build (fa-fail) ran record-ref.js write, and each records ref's discovered.jsonl holds the 'filed .../issues/101' marker for the FS-1 row that was filed.

Fresh walk: read-blocking-policy with must-pass declared returned policy 'all', declared 'must-pass' and a non-empty waiverRefused for each of absent, none, unparseable and an unreachable GitHub tracker.
Fresh walk: with a stub gh repo view that succeeds, read-blocking-policy kept policy 'must-pass' and returned no waiverRefused.

Fresh /verify-build session called read-blocking-policy with --stack and passed blockingNote (the waiverRefused text) to the Workflow beside blocking:'all'. The /implement-trd half is proven from its §8.1a command text (same --stack call, blockingNote set from waiverRefused and passed in the workflow args), not a live run.

Fresh /verify-build --cap 1 on the Tracker-none, must-pass-declared fixture: outcome stuck, not satisfied; the failing ordinary criterion FS-2 is not_met and neither the report nor the state file has a non-blocking entry.

Rendered with blockingNote, the report has one **Blocking** line in the required wording. Rendered without it, the report is byte-identical (cmp) to the pre-change main render, and the two renders differ only by that line.
The final report of a fixture run that went through a fix round (a cause closed at iteration 2) and a regression-pass re-render still carries the **Blocking** line.
The DECISIONS section of the fresh /verify-build readout says verification.md asks for a must-pass-only policy but it was not applied, because no tracker is declared, so every failure blocks.

The sequence ran three gates, recordNonBlockingFollowups, a newer waived row and /ship-build file-followups, and the gh log has exactly one issue create. The second gate lists FS-9 in already, recordNonBlockingFollowups skips FS-9, the newer row is marked filed with the same URL, and no open waived rows remain.
Fresh walk: record-filed wrote the 'filed .../issues/777' marker, the next gate printed ok:true with FS-9 in already, and that gate run made no gh call (issue-create count 0).

Fresh walk: across every gate run the stub gh saw only issue create, label create, label list and repo view (none outside the four), and ship-primitive-close-issue.md line 34 (both copies) says a waived-defect issue is closed only when a later feature cites it as its source.
Fresh successful closes: the STATE section of both /close-feature (fc-ok) and /audit-build (fa-ok) lists FS-1 and FS-2 each beside its stub issue URL (issues/101 and issues/102).
